q: the sky and by that which appears by night!
v.s: By the sky and the night comer
v.c: By the heaven and the nightly star!
v.h: Allah’s Power to Create and Resurrect

q: How will you know what it is that appears by night?
v.s: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
v.c: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is?
˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness.

q: There is no soul without a watcher
(to keep record of all its actions).
v.s: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
v.c: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺.

q: should think about what he was created from.
v.s: So let man observe from what he was created.
v.c: Let people then consider what they were created from!

q: He was created from spurting water
v.s: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
v.c: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid,

q: ...which emerges from between the backbone and the chest.
(This is a reference to men's loins and women's chests)
v.s: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
v.c: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage.

q: (just as Allaah had the power to create man from nothing,)
has the power to raise him
v.s: Indeed, He [i.e., God], to return him [to life], is Able.
v.c: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺

q: The day when secrets will be examined
(and people will either be rewarded or punished).
v.s: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
v.c: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed.

q: There shall then neither be any power
v.s: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.
v.c: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper.

q: the sky from which rain falls...
v.c: By the sky with its recurring cycles,

q: (opens to make way for sprouting plants)!
v.s: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
v.c: and the earth with its sprouting plants!

v.s: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,
v.c: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word,
and is not to be taken lightly.

v.s: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

q: (to ensure that their plots ultimately fail).
v.s: But I am planning a plan.

q: (allow them a short period from punishment).
Grant them respite for a while
(for they will soon suffer terribly for their evils)).
v.s: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
v.c: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while.
